slides.title: Tensor Product
text: Tensor product is a way to “multiply” two vectors into another one.
We deal with two tensor types and the associated tensor products:
• High-order Cartesian tensors are created from naïve tensor products.
• High-order spherical tensors are created from Clebsch-gordan tensor products,
or simply tensor product plus Clebsch-gordan decomposition.
